Acne.description: Acne causes pimples, blackheads, and oily skin due to blocked pores.
Acne.medical_treatment: Topical retinoids, benzoyl peroxide, antibiotics, or hormonal therapy if severe.
Acne.home_remedies: Wash face gently twice daily, avoid touching your face, use non-comedogenic products.
Acne.diet: Eat more fruits, vegetables, and whole grains; reduce sugary and greasy foods.

Actinic Keratosis.description: Rough, scaly patches on sun-exposed skin caused by sun damage.
Actinic Keratosis.home_remedies: Avoid excessive sun, use sunscreen SPF 30+, wear protective clothing.
Actinic Keratosis.diet: Antioxidant-rich foods like berries and leafy greens.

Basal Cell Carcinoma.description: A slow-growing skin cancer appearing as pearly or shiny bumps.
Basal Cell Carcinoma.medical_treatment: Surgical excision, Mohs surgery, or topical chemotherapy for small lesions.
Basal Cell Carcinoma.home_remedies: Protect skin from sun, monitor changes in moles or bumps.
Basal Cell Carcinoma.diet: Healthy diet with antioxidants to support skin health.

Chickenpox.description: Highly contagious viral infection causing itchy red spots and blisters.
Chickenpox.medical_treatment: Antiviral medications (like acyclovir) for severe cases.
Chickenpox.home_remedies: Oatmeal baths, calamine lotion, keep skin clean and nails trimmed.
Chickenpox.diet: Hydrating foods and fluids; light, easy-to-digest meals.

Dermato Fibroma.description: Small, firm, benign skin bumps that are harmless.
Dermato Fibroma.medical_treatment: Usually not needed; surgical removal if bothersome.

Dyshidrotic Eczema.description: Itchy blisters on hands or feet, often triggered by stress or allergies.
Dyshidrotic Eczema.home_remedies: Keep hands and feet dry, use moisturizers, avoid irritants.
Dyshidrotic Eczema.diet: Reduce processed foods; include omega-3 fatty acids.

Melanoma.description: A dangerous skin cancer that can spread quickly, often dark or irregular moles.
Melanoma.medical_treatment: Surgical excision, immunotherapy, targeted therapy if advanced.
Melanoma.home_remedies: Early detection; avoid excessive sun exposure and tanning beds.
Melanoma.diet: Antioxidant-rich foods like vegetables, fruits, and green tea.

Nail Fungus.description: Fungal infection causing thick, discolored, or brittle nails.
Nail Fungus.medical_treatment: Oral antifungal medications, medicated nail creams.
Nail Fungus.home_remedies: Keep nails clean and dry, avoid nail trauma, wear breathable shoes.
Nail Fungus.diet: Foods supporting immunity like garlic, yogurt, and nuts.

Nevus.description: A common mole or birthmark, usually harmless.
Nevus.medical_treatment: Removal if suspicious or for cosmetic reasons.
Nevus.home_remedies: Monitor for changes in size, shape, or color.

Normal Skin.description: Healthy skin with no visible disease or abnormality.
Normal Skin.home_remedies: Maintain hydration, cleanse gently, and use sunscreen.
Normal Skin.diet: Balanced diet with vitamins and minerals for skin health.

Pigmented Benign Keratosis.description: Non-cancerous, pigmented skin growths, usually brown or black.
Pigmented Benign Keratosis.diet: Maintain a healthy diet rich in antioxidants.

Ringworm.description: Fungal infection causing ring-shaped, itchy rashes.
Ringworm.home_remedies: Keep affected area clean and dry; avoid sharing towels.
Ringworm.diet: Foods boosting immunity like garlic, yogurt, and vegetables.

Seborrheic Keratosis.home_remedies: No special home treatment; monitor for changes.

Squamous Cell Carcinoma.description: A common skin cancer appearing as scaly red patches or sores.
Squamous Cell Carcinoma.medical_treatment: Surgical removal, radiation, or topical chemotherapy.
Squamous Cell Carcinoma.home_remedies: Protect skin from sun, monitor suspicious lesions.
Squamous Cell Carcinoma.diet: Eat antioxidant-rich foods like fruits, vegetables, and nuts.

Vascular Lesion.description: Abnormalities in blood vessels, like birthmarks or red spots.
Vascular Lesion.medical_treatment: Laser therapy or observation if harmless.
Vascular Lesion.diet: Maintain a healthy diet and avoid smoking.
